topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stood there, the spot where my tree once stood now bare, only a whisper of its presence lingering in the air. I planted that tree when I was just a child, my hands dirty and my heart full. Each year, I watched it grow taller, its branches reaching out like arms, welcoming the seasons with a grace that only nature understands. Now, all that remains are memories, but they are enough. In my mind, the tree still stands, a silent guardian of the past, and I am grateful for every moment we shared.
